review_scope: Independent preliminary load-path and nominal interface review of build_c2.py and calculations.json; not engineering or fabrication approval.
recommendation: Four-bolt steel-bypass topology with3/4in cap and sole is coherent as a dimensioned preliminary candidate. Strength is not passed: include local combined inertia, actual frame/joint stiffness, contact and prying. Avoid repeated thickening; investigate a lighter braced load path next.

corrected_connection.old_two_bolt_issue: Both original bolts shared X; they lacked a finite longitudinal row lever. Sole edges float above floor and must not be assumed compression toes. Real steel spacers define the compression path.

fit_review.socket_status: Real nut, washer, socket profile, axial approach and weld access remain to verify. Do not expand preliminary allowances into approved fit.
fit_review.floor_closure: Use a removable nonstructural flexible closure; do not fill clearance with a rigid load bridge or clamp sandwich core. Thermal movement, floor-loaded deflection, sealing and cleanability require qualification.
fit_review.back_panel_sleeve: Read geometry uses 1.5in length through actual 1.5in HSS front/back faces, rather than floating tabs; match production tube width and bore/flush requirements.

backrest_comparison.basis: 600lbf total atZ67, comparison only; no gravity credit
backrest_comparison.warning: Neither full-footprint axial couple nor half-load fixed-rear-foot model is a validated stiffness distribution; they are alternative screens.

additional_combined_inertia_local_case.assumption: Half of both horizontal loads/moments taken by each rear foot; no gravity reduction of bolt tension. Analyst concurrent sensitivity, not mandated code case.
additional_combined_inertia_local_case.finding: This exceeds the backrest-case bolt demand. Revised3/4cap gives171.795MPa illustrative strip stress, compared with247.385MPa at5/8. Effective strip width, holes, contact and prying remain unproven; this comparison is not joint acceptance. Cap top31.753937in, spacer12.6mm, sole32.25..33in.

open_strength_checks: Cap/sole two-way bending, hole net section, bearing/contact, prying and realistic effective widths
Cap-to-cheek weld group must transmit moment plus shear; direct-force weld screen is insufficient
Cheek welds must terminate on measured HSS side flats; rounded corners and minimum effective lengths need actual profile/fit-up
Seat-rail local wall/corner yielding, torsion and end-joint load transfer into adjacent crossmembers
Leg-to-sole and seat-frame weld groups with both back-force signs, racking, cyclic loading and lateral combinations
Bolt grip/thread/shear-plane position, actual locking system, installation preload and torque
Complete pan/backplate attachment, upholstery retention, passenger impact/egress and prototype acceptance
mass_review: Final CAD/catalog metal and main hardware total61.470435899kg per bench including hardpoints; the65kg planning allowance leaves3.529564101kg for padding, trim, small fasteners and closures. This is calculated mass, not weighed tare. Investigate a lighter braced frame with realistic joint stiffness before further plate-thickness iteration.
next_development: After publishing the honest dimensioned candidate, compare braced frame/global foot-couple topology and complete mass/CG coordination; final hardpoint load sharing must come from a justified stiffness/contact model and physical tests.
